thread.title: Jim Cramer on Apple: Look at Services Revenue

author: thestreet.com
title: Jim Cramer on Apple: Look at Services Revenue
text:
TheStreet's founder and Action Alerts PLUS Portfolio Manager Jim Cramer said declaring Apple ( AAPL ) 'dead' off of the upcoming earnings is the "old way of looking" at the company.
"I think that you look at services revenue; I think that you look at the ecosystem; I think you realize that you've got tiers - you can have a $1,000 phone and a phone much lower," Cramer noted.
